column5: mg/kg translates to milligrams per kilogram. It is a metric unit of measurement used to express the concentration of a substance in relation to a given weight
Mg.ha^-1 is the scientific abbreviation for megagrams per hectare. One megagram is equal to 1 metric tonne (1,000 kg or 1,000,000 g)
cmol/kg stands for centimoles per kilogram. It is a metric unit of measurement used primarily in agronomy and soil science to express Cation-Exchange Capacity (CEC) and exchangeable plant nutrients
g/kg translates to grams per kilogram. It is a metric unit of measurement used to express the concentration of a substance in relation to a given weight

mm/h stands for millimeters per hour. It is a metric unit of measurement used to describe the intensity of rainfall or precipitation. It measures the depth of water that would accumulate on a flat surface in one hour
kg.m^-2 Kilograms per square metre, is a metric measurement for area density (or surface mass). It tells you the mass of an object or substance spread evenly over a given area.

In soil science, dS/m stands for deciSiemens per meter, which is the standard SI unit used to measure electrical conductivity (EC). It indicates how well a soil conducts an electrical current, serving as a direct measure of soil salinity and available nutrients.
